items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: he's the man reminding me how to, uh, stretch my fingers.

ctx.x: He's a boss piano player. Respected by Orlheim, Duke, and anybody. Is he still living? I saw... I think he is, but he, he, uh, he's the man reminding me how to, uh, stretch my fingers. Always, I had that old trap style, you know, and, uh, I was, uh, always wanted to be a tent man, you know, like, in old timers, that, uh, as Miss Slim, his old partner, Rabbit, you know, the tent, and them walk in them tents, and, and that was for the shuffle like Louis J. come out back in them days. So, P. R. was graduated. He,…
They were singing with a feeling.
